'''Ionic pulse regulators''' were integral components of the [[Aeramaxis Technologies]] [[PDW-50 Ionic Tingler]]. The pulse regulators energized [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] particles which the weapon's ammunition shells, charging them up within 10 minutes.
